$comment: Per-PR perf gate expectations (#927 P2). Integers the product counts about itself on the golden year-3 vault, measured by tests/perf/work-counters.perf.test.ts and compared by scripts/ci/work-counter-gate.mjs. TIGHTEN-ONLY: lowering a number is a normal commit; raising one is the thing a reviewer must see, and needs the receipt to say what got more expensive and why. `max` is a budget — anything above it fails. `exact` is for a value where BOTH directions are a regression: a durability barrier that disappears is a durability bug, not a speed-up.

gateway.read core.party limit=20.$comment: An owner-direct read of 20 rows. Owner allow reads skip access receipts, so this path has no durable append; the exact zero fsync budget preserves that invariant (packages/vault/src/gateway/evidence.ts).

gateway.invoke atlas.insert_row core.pla.$comment: One user write through the real command path. FIVE durability barriers for one row — five separate autocommit writes rather than one transaction. Recorded as measured, not as approved; see the #927 w1-gate receipt's findings.
